title: Multi-Shuriken Throw
body:
Syntax: multi-shuriken throw <target>

Description: Throws three carried shuriken in one attack. Spent shuriken land on the room floor. Requires a carried shuriken. Base damage: 12-16. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 10. Costs 0 Chakra and 12 Stamina; 4 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
